studio.name: Shree Games & Apps
studio.tagline: Crafting worlds worth playing in. One game at a time.

apps.name: Neon Breakout: Cyber Bricks
apps.desc: Break glowing neon bricks in this fast-paced arcade classic. Smooth paddle controls, stunning neon visuals, and an endless high-score chase — all offline.

apps.name: Neon Dodge: Hyperflux
apps.desc: Dodge neon obstacles, survive longer, and master the endless challenge! in this fast-paced arcade classic. Smooth controls, stunning neon visuals, and an endless high-score chase — all offline.

apps.name: Burst The Bubble
apps.desc: Every level in Burst the Bubble is generated fresh — new shapes, new hazards, gradually rising difficulty, forever. Aim, chain color combos, dodge moving obstacles, and take down bubble bosses, all with a mascot who's never short of a comment. — all offline.

apps.name: Chaturanga
apps.desc: The ancient game of kings, reimagined for Android. Experience chess as it was played in the courts of ancient India — with a full economy, leagues, and multiplayer.
